What's Inside

Ingredients That Actually Work

No fillers. No hidden chemicals. Only premium, science-backed ingredients chosen for real results on all skin types.

🍄
Tremella Mushroom
5x more hydrating than Hyaluronic Acid — a natural ingredient that locks in moisture at a cellular level for glass skin, plump texture and a youthful appearance.
🍉
Watermelon Extract
Hydrates as it cleanses — packed with antioxidants and vitamins that refresh, soothe and brighten sensitive skin without any fragrance or irritants.
💧
Squalane
A barrier-strengthening lipid that locks in moisture, protects against environmental damage and leaves skin silky smooth.
🧈
Shea Butter
Deeply nourishes and softens skin — rich in vitamins A and E for lasting hydration and a luminous, healthy glow.
🍊
Vitamin C
Brightens skin tone, fades dark spots and gives skin a luminous, golden glow that lasts.
🌿
Niacinamide
Minimizes pores, evens skin tone and strengthens the skin barrier for a healthy, smooth complexion.
🌹
Rose & Rose Hip Oil
Natural rose scent for a luxurious sensory experience — plus Rose Hip Oil rich in essential fatty acids that regenerate skin cells and reduce scars and fine lines.

Our Story

From Nairobi to
Las Vegas

GoldenLip Skin was born in Nairobi, Kenya — built on the same vision as GoldenLip Cosmetics. A deep belief that every woman deserves luxury clean skincare that truly performs.

After building a successful luxury makeup brand, our founder Margaret Wachera saw a gap — women needed a clean skincare line that matched their makeup's luxury and performance. GoldenLip Skin was created to complete the ritual.

Every moisturiser is formulated with premium, clean ingredients inspired by the rich botanicals of Kenya. Currently shipping across Kenya — and coming soon to the United States! This is skincare with soul.
